dataset.title: MCD19A2.061 Terra & Aqua MAIAC Land Aerosol Optical Depth Daily 1 km
dataset.quantity: Aerosol optical depth at 550 nm (column-integrated, atmosphere total)
dataset.citation: MODIS/Terra+Aqua Land Aerosol Optical Depth Daily L2G Global 1km SIN Grid V061 (MCD19A2.061). NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC. https://doi.org/10.5067/MODIS/MCD19A2.061 - see the LP DAAC 'Citing Our Data' page for the full citation format.

core_qa.name: core_qa
core_qa.text: AOD_QA bits 0-2 == 1 (clear) AND bits 3-4 == 0 (land) AND bits 8-11 == 0 (best quality)

documented_value_guard.name: documented_value_guard
documented_value_guard.text: Every non-core AOD_QA field must hold a documented value: adjacency bits 5-7 in {0..5}, glint bit 12 in {0,1}, aerosol model bits 13-14 in {0,1,2}, reserved bit 15 == 0. Retrievals failing only this guard are rejected and counted as qa_guard_rejections, never silently accepted.

any_documented.text: Adjacency bits 5-7 are decoded but not used to filter (any documented value accepted).

variants.label: Primary - core QA, product valid range
variants.text: Core QA + documented-value guard; raw Optical_Depth_055 in [-100, 8000] (AOD -0.100..8.000); adjacency not filtered. No clamping: small negative AOD is kept.

variants.label: Sensitivity - non-negative AOD only
variants.text: As primary, but raw Optical_Depth_055 in [0, 8000] (AOD 0.000..8.000). Negative retrievals are excluded, not set to zero.

variants.label: Sensitivity - cloud-adjacency clear only
variants.text: As primary, plus AOD_QA adjacency bits 5-7 == 0.

spatial_rule.grid: MAIAC native sinusoidal projection (taken from the collection's own Optical_Depth_055 band; no scale override)
spatial_rule.reducers: unweighted for every statistic (pixel sums, per-granule counts and means)
spatial_rule.text: All ROI statistics use the MAIAC native sinusoidal grid and Earth Engine unweighted reducers: a pixel is included when its centre lies inside the ROI. Pixel-level sums and per-granule counts use the identical rule.

temporal_rule.text: Per-pixel statistics use all QA-passing granule retrievals with system:time_start in [start, end_exclusive) (UTC). Granules are independent overpass retrievals; a valid day is a UTC calendar day with >= 1 valid retrieval anywhere in the ROI.

statistic_definitions.pixels_total: Number of MAIAC native-grid pixels whose centre lies inside the ROI.
statistic_definitions.pixels_with_valid: Number of ROI pixels with at least one valid retrieval in the period.
statistic_definitions.coverage_fraction: pixels_with_valid / pixels_total; null when pixels_total is 0.
statistic_definitions.valid_retrievals: Sum over ROI pixels of the per-pixel count of valid granule retrievals (pixel-level sum).
statistic_definitions.valid_retrievals_granule_sum: Sum over granules of each granule's count of valid ROI pixels (per-granule sum); must equal valid_retrievals.
statistic_definitions.retrievals_before_qa: Sum over ROI pixels of granule retrievals whose raw Optical_Depth_055 is present and inside the product valid range [-100, 8000], before any QA test.
statistic_definitions.qa_retention_fraction: valid_retrievals / retrievals_before_qa; null when retrievals_before_qa is 0.
statistic_definitions.qa_guard_rejections: Retrievals inside the product valid range that pass core QA but fail the documented-value guard (undocumented or reserved AOD_QA values).
statistic_definitions.granules_intersecting: Number of granules whose footprint intersects the ROI in the period.
statistic_definitions.granules_with_valid: Number of granules with at least one valid ROI pixel.
statistic_definitions.valid_day_count: Number of distinct UTC days with at least one valid retrieval anywhere in the ROI.
statistic_definitions.roi_mean_aod: Unweighted mean, over ROI pixels with >= 1 valid retrieval, of each pixel's period-mean AOD (mean of per-pixel period means). null when no valid retrieval.
statistic_definitions.roi_pooled_retrieval_mean_aod: Mean of all valid pixel-level retrievals pooled together (sum of AOD over every valid pixel retrieval / valid_retrievals). A different statistic from roi_mean_aod; null when no valid retrieval.

acceptance.note: Parity evidence shows the backend reproduces the Code Editor computation for one ROI and month. It is not scientific validation of the AOD product or of any attribution.
